name: Duck Hunters: Happy Hour

features.name: Scatter wins
features.description: Eight or more matching symbols anywhere.

review:
Duck Hunters: Happy Hour is a scatter-pays spin-off on a 4-5-6-6-5-4 grid. Eight or more matching symbols win and drop out, xWays reveal symbols with 2x, 4x or 8x position multipliers, and infectious xWays spread to neighbours.

Bombs remove regular symbols in a 3x3 area and double the multipliers there. Nolimit rates it Extreme volatility, with a 33,333x cap. The diamond-shaped grid makes the middle positions the most valuable.
pros: Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Very high volatility – long dry spells are normal
Bonus buy is costly and banned in some markets (e.g. Great Britain)
Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
